archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & SWISS HYBRID

brand_identity.name: Strativate
brand_identity.description: Platform pelatihan bisnis, akuntansi, persiapan kompetisi bisnis (business case/plan/equity research), dan mentoring intensif profesional.
brand_identity.primary_emotion: Energetic, ambitious, highly structured, confidence-inspiring, and distinctly human.

rules.headings: Outfit with tight letter-spacing (-0.03em to -0.06em), leading-tight, bold/extrabold
rules.body: DM Sans with 1.5-1.7 line height for high legibility

entry_surfaces./: split hero with narrative value prop on left and Supabase-managed active hero poster carousel / brand fallback card on right
entry_surfaces./program: program directory showcasing Private Mentoring and Intensive Mentoring with feature comparisons and curriculum badges
entry_surfaces./program/private-mentoring: immersive mentorship detail view with mentor selector, curriculum breakdown, and WhatsApp consultation action
entry_surfaces./program/intensive-mentoring: deep-dive multi-week bootcamp syllabus with milestone steps, mentor roster, and registration trigger
entry_surfaces./mentor: equal-height mentor directory grid with search, tier filtering (Young Professional / Top Student), credentials tags, and quick-view modal
entry_surfaces./tentang-kami: split editorial brand manifesto with high-contrast mission blocks, founder pillars, and institutional track records
entry_surfaces./tanya-jawab: clean searchable accordion FAQ with categorized cards and immediate WhatsApp support link
entry_surfaces./auth: branded two-column split screen with positioning statement left and unified login/register entry right
entry_surfaces./admin/marketing: management workspace for hero posters carousel upload, drag/order reordering, active toggling, and Supabase Storage synchronization

visual_enhancers.motion: AOS reveal animations (fade-up, fade-in, stagger delays of 80-120ms) using CSS transitions and prefers-reduced-motion media compliance
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle border strokes (1px border-neutral-200), layered soft shadows, and warm organic accent backdrops (bg-[#fff0e5], bg-[#ffe79d])
interactivity: Hero carousel with touch gestures, timer auto-play pause on hover/focus, indicator dots, and image links
Contextual floating WhatsApp consultation pill with pathname-aware prefilled consultation copy
Mentor directory equal-height cards with interactive full-profile modal trigger
Admin drag/up-down order management for hero posters connected directly to Supabase table and Storage bucket

digital_products.state: digitalProducts: false (hidden globally without deleting schema/types)
digital_products.behavior: Routes and navigation hide all digital products, while preserving core types and checkout compatibility

explore_retirement.behavior: Permanent redirect (307/308 or Next.js redirect()) to /program

accessibility.contrast: All text tokens meet minimum 4.5:1 ratio against their defined surface backgrounds (e.g. #D95204 on white/warm-tint, #111827 on white, #FFFFFF on #18202A).
accessibility.focus_indicators: Clear 2px ring with brand accent offset on keyboard navigation.
accessibility.data_testids: Strict kebab-case testids included across all interactive controls (hero-poster-carousel, global-whatsapp-cta, mentor-search-input, mentor-card, hero-poster-admin-section, etc.).

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain real Supabase client and server interactions for hero posters and storage operations; do not replace with in-memory mocks in production routes.
Verify that the digitalProducts feature flag in lib/features.ts remains false and hides digital product UI without breaking test suites.
Ensure all mentor cards remain equal height via grid stretch and CSS flex column layout.
Maintain the WhatsApp floating CTA with contextual messaging matching the current route pathname.
Keep /explore redirecting to /program and verify all navigation headers point to active programs and mentors.
